question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's entrenched control as CCP General Secretary, Central Military Commission chairman, and state president underpins the 95.9% trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Since abolishing presidential term limits in 2018, he has centralized authority through personnel appointments and military leadership changes that have eliminated potential rivals without triggering elite opposition. Public continuity in policy and appearances through mid-2026, ahead of the 21st Party Congress, aligns with historical patterns where major transitions occur at scheduled congresses rather than abruptly. Speculation around health or factional challenges remains unsubstantiated in primary reporting. Low-probability shifts could still arise from a sudden medical issue, acute economic pressures fostering internal consensus for change, or an external crisis eroding cohesion before December 2026.
